decisions.reason: The formwork profile line sits in the core offer and had its own page, so the expanding firm has no performance shortfall that would trigger problemistic search, although its absence from the website in 2020 to 2021 adds some uncertainty.

Shuttering magnet blocks are a low-cost staple of precast formwork that slack in a growing firm can easily carry, though the 2019 pruning of related magnetic items and its missing web presence raise the risk somewhat.

Comparable magnetic formwork components (D and E) were already withdrawn, F was only mentioned and has not been visible since 2019, so consolidating it frees resources for core business and new development amid rising costs in 2022.
